Each header is literally true of its chunk's content: "Write the failing test and fix the root cause" (L13) matches L15-18's write-test/fix-cause instructions; "Read the diff and push back on a line" (L24) matches L26-27; "Interrogate the fix for a deeper layer" (L29) matches L31-41's root-cause-vs-layer interrogation; "There is always a next plausible answer" (L43) matches L45's "there will be a next plausible answer" almost verbatim; "Ship the PR" (L47) matches L49's commit/push/PR instruction.

Checked all six sub-items across all 6 chunks: no "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction; no anaphora/epistrophe triple; no self-grading superlative (closest, L9 widget "**The point:** pushing back is core work." is a plain value statement about the exercise, not a superlative claim like "one of the most useful moves"); no number-plus-retraction (L3's "25 minutes" is a plain time budget, never hedged or retracted); no abstraction-noun stack (body stays concrete: bug, test, diff, fix, PR, layer); no verb triplet with an empty leg.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Four headings are imperative/phase-style ("Write the failing test and fix the root cause", "Read the diff and push back on a line", "Interrogate the fix for a deeper layer", "Ship the PR"); one, "There is always a next plausible answer" (chunk 4, L43), is the deliberate declarative — the compendium's own §15 text names this exact file/heading as one of only two earned declaratives measured across all 15 AE101 exercise files (2026-08-15), and maintainer accept-note L57 attests it directly, including the header-truth guard (body says "will always try to find," never "finds" — not strengthened, verified L45).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest calls: L27 "Your own wording matters. No pre-made prompt for the pushback. The compound step reads this session's scrollback, so your push-back is what becomes a rule." stays inside class (b) because it adds new operational content — WHY freeform wording is required (it feeds the compound step) — rather than commenting on the training's own design philosophy with nothing new. L31's closing clause "The exchange is where root-cause discipline shows up, not in the fix itself" stays inside class (a) because it adds a placement claim (WHERE the discipline is exhibited) rather than re-announcing the L15 tests-first/root-cause doctrine verbatim. Chunk 4's bullet (L45) is the slide's sole substantive content, not a closing aphorism restating the header per class (c) — it adds the causal mechanism ("because the LLM will always try to find what you asked for") and a consequence ("when to stop digging is your call"). Maintainer's 2026-08-25 lean-intro trim (L59) independently confirms the file is actively kept lean.
